fato_historico: 1983: Hurricane Alicia hits the Texas coast, killing 21 people and causing over US$1 billion in damage (1983 dollars).
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with a powerful, transformative vibration today. Just as a mighty hurricane reshapes the coastline, your internal landscape may be shifting toward a new foundation. Consider how these powerful winds of change can clear away old debris, leaving you refreshed and ready to grow. It is a wonderful time to honor your resilience and find inner calm.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest storms eventually clear the way for a beautiful, vibrant rainbow.
significado_numero: Represents the collective strength found in unity and shared personal growth.
conselho: Stand tall in your truth and let your authentic spirit weather any challenge.
